test_scenario: Verify that a user can control video playback functionalities (fullscreen, play/pause, volume) during a live video session.
test_case_title: Verify user can control video playback
pre_condition: A user (Teacher or Student) is logged in, enrolled in the course, and has joined an active video session where a video stream is active.
expected_result: The user can successfully toggle fullscreen, play/pause the video stream, and adjust the volume.
post_condition: Video playback controls are confirmed to be functional.

test_steps.step: User verifies the video enters fullscreen mode.
User clicks the 'Play/Pause' button to pause the video.
User clicks the 'Play/Pause' button to resume the video.
User verifies the audio volume changes accordingly.

uncovered_conditions: Normal Flow: Common Action 4 (User can control the video playback)
